rules: Axes are independent; implemented never implies installed or native-qualified.
Retained-report evidence is not fresh worker readback.
Test source paths do not imply tests were executed; see verification.json for exact executed commands.
No status or proposal grants authority, installs a runtime, or closes a root graph gate.

capabilities.capability: Acyclic prerequisites and ready/blocked branches

implemented.boundary: needs edges are DAG prerequisites; task hierarchy and feedback are different relations.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: Do not represent retry with a prerequisite cycle.

capabilities.capability: Failure-to-pending repair cycle and method feedback

implemented.boundary: A gate decides completion; feedback is advisory and does not enforce model compliance.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: Task-specific failure classification and bounded retry acceptance remain necessary.

capabilities.capability: Declared input/check/output and definition binding

implemented.boundary: Opt-in ## versions: v1; no automatic binding for undeclared files or runtime environment.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: Root v2-completion graph is currently unversioned; bind acceptance-relevant environment via an explicit artifact.

capabilities.capability: Join on all current required prerequisite results

implemented.boundary: Parent receipts are bound by needs; integration must run its own gate.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: Require explicit terminal dependencies and integration acceptance; a child report is insufficient.

capabilities.capability: Invalidate changed dependency closure, retain unrelated work

implemented.boundary: Current version inspection observes staleness; refresh persists reopening without stealing live leases.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: Cross-graph invalidation and automatically discovered dependencies are absent.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: No transaction spanning graph/source/memory files and SQLite.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: Check actual process/ownership before takeover; no global cross-device lock.

capabilities.capability: Revalidate linked memory and evidence before claim/renew

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: Consumer must not clear stale dependencies through put; revalidate on sensitive use and unchanged cursors.

capabilities.capability: Durable goal/checkpoint/next and explicit blocks

implemented.boundary: Checkpoint/evidence presence/hash is reference only; unavailable state is not fresh empty state.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.capability: Bounded project-local packet inspection without registry

implemented.boundary: <=16KiB per Markdown packet, <=64KiB aggregate, <=100 entries; hashes are data only.

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.

capabilities.missing_or_next: No semantic packet validator, freshness oracle, message delivery or auto-dispatch.

capabilities.capability: Branch-scoped NOT_RUN holds and independent continuation

native_qualified.claim: No broad or current-client qualification inferred from source tests.
